newsitem.title: UK: French builder rolls out first Kuwaiti patrol boat.
newsitem.headline: French builder rolls out first Kuwaiti patrol boat.

text.p: French warship builder Constructions Mecaniques de Normandie (CMN) said it had "rolled out" the first of eight patrol boats for Kuwait on Friday.
CMN said construction of the fast patrol boat for the Kuwait Naval Forces was nearing completion at its Cherbourg shipyard.
"The first of the new Combattante 1 class boats was rolled out from the construction hall at Cherbourg, exactly on time within the original 1995 project programme," it said.
The shipbuilder added that sea trials of the vessel would be completed during the summer. A second vessel would also be completed later this summer, it said.
CMN said construction of the hulls and superstructures of a further two boats was at an advanced stage and that work on another two vessels was also under way.
The 42 metre long patrol boats, which have a cruising range of 2,300 nautical miles and a speed of more than 30 knots, were ordered in 1995 to replace losses Kuwait suffered in the Gulf War.

The vessels, which will be fitted with the MATRA/BAe Sea Skua surface to surface missile system, will be deployed in coastal defence operations in the restricted waters at the head of the Arabian Gulf.
